subject: Room credentialing, master-bill credits, and privacy checklist for Redwood workshop
messages:
From: Elena Morris <elena.morris@stratuspartners.com>

Date: 2026-05-28T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Hotel access and master-bill room credits for Redwood workshop

Hi Priyom / Marcus,

Thanks for confirming Redwood's 2-day workshop at The Meridian next month. A few items we need to lock before we publish the final guest packet:

- Master-bill credits: we need to confirm which rooms are on master (Redwood pays) vs individual pickup. If you can send a preliminary rooming list by EOD Friday we can reconcile rates with the hotel.
- Access credentials: the hotel supports mobile key and physical keycards. Executive privacy requests (private corridors, adjacent suites) require front-desk flagging and a single named concierge liaison. Please confirm if you want mobile keys enabled for all delegates or limit to execs.
- Security doors / after-hours access: there is a vendor door code we can provision to your team for the evening reception; please confirm who should have it.
- Attachments: site_layout.pdf attached with proposed suite pairings and loading dock windows.

Proposed next steps: send rooming list (name, arrival/departure, room type preference, dietary flag), indicate which 2 rooms need enhanced privacy, and confirm concierge point of contact.

Happy to jump on a 15-min call if that helps.

Best,
Elena Morris
Director, Venue Partnerships
Stratus Partners Events

Elena — thanks for the clear list. Quick answers and our ask list below.

1) Master-bill: Redwood will cover sleeping rooms for 18 internal attendees + 2 exec suites (master-bill). All other guests (partners/vendors) will pick up their own rooms. Please hold 25 rooms total with that split; we'll finalize names tomorrow.
2) Mobile keys: enable mobile keys for everyone. For the two exec suites, also issue physical keycards and flag "Do not list room on directory."
3) Security door code: provision to Marcus (marcus.lin@redwood.inference) and event lead (elena.morris@stratuspartners.com). We'll use the code for vendor load-in only between 16:00-18:00 on day 0.
4) Concierge liaison: Marissa Cole (marissa.cole@redwood.inference) will be the primary contact on-site. Please loop her for VIP arrival times.

Rooming list: we're finalizing names; expect an initial CSV by Friday morning. I copied Marcus so he can add the rooming matrix and any door-code constraints.

Thanks — Priyom
Priyom Das
Events & Partnerships, Redwood Inference
